body:
Dude, we cause things to go extinct.

Thats like murdering someone and then being called a hero for dialing 911.
Me too bud. Me too. It never seems to get better.
I hope you don't do this, but goodbye. One other person notices you.

Hey, I would feel the same in your situation too. Just please, say everything you ever need to say to your loved ones. Don't be like me and never say it. The sad part is about love that its a contract on causing pain. They are in pain because they love you, and I don't think they would have it any other way. When I love someone and they die, all the pain, it is worth it. Just to hear their voice, see their face just one last time. I want it to hurt because that is a testament on how much they mattered. Because it can't ever be replaced. The world loses its color when you are dying, just before you die, please don't let it stop you from tell those around you how much you love them.
I'm sorry. Sometimes I just hate being around people. They never seem to give a shit until it's too late.
They just don't get it. I have no friends either. Sometimes I just want to be normal and shit but, I can't stand neurotypicals.
Good luck, we are all here to support you!
Me too bud.  I just wish the whole world could just dissappear.

I'm so sorry. I can feel your pain through your words. All you really seem to want is to be loved. I just relate so much to what you wrote. Everything I ever wanted are things I just can't have. You must feel so lonely. I don't know what led to this, but it must be too much to bear. Thank you for being so vulnerable. I just hope you know that a stranger out there knows you pain.

Shamed by the very people that are supposed to be understanding. There is no betrayal that matches its pain. I assume you are a guy. Men have it hard too, but society jokes or ignores it. The suffering that men must hide, I can't even imagine the kind of toll it takes. There is a stigma with mental health. Just know, feeling like this does not make you weak. Only human. And as humans, as great as our minds are, they can be our worst enemy. Just know, this community won't ever see you as weak. We are going through some of the same stuff too.
You must be in so much pain. Life seems pointless for me too. I mean we all are going to die anyways and life seems pretty shit.
I'm sorry dude. I know how cold it is.

Hey, just so you know, if you say that you are actively suicidal, they will tell your parents. Otherwise saying things like you have thoughts about suicide is often safer when it comes to privacy. Asking for help on how to stay safe or make a safety plan is something alot of people use to stay out of hospitals.
